JupyterLiteEnabled.description: Master switch. The static site is served by the web server whether or not this is set, so this only governs the launcher and the config API.

JupyterLiteBasePath.description: Where the built site is served from. Must be same-origin with the wiki: that is what lets the in-browser kernel reach the wiki API with the user's own session instead of a credential.

JupyterLiteSettings.description: Server-side defaults handed to the in-browser agent, e.g. {"provider": "azure-foundry-anthropic", "model": "...", "baseURL": "https://.../llm"}. Applied as defaults only: a user who has changed the setting keeps their choice. Never put an API key here - this file is readable by anyone who can read the container, and the value is served to every entitled user.
